posts.title: Decline Curve Analysis
posts.description: Decline Curve Analysis is a method for forecasting oil and gas production in wells. The idea dates back to the early 1900s and involves fitting a parametric curve to the time series data. It’s extremely fast and robust, and despite its simplicity it often produces very accurate forecasts.

posts.title: Minimal models and dumb deployments
posts.description: The most common mistake I encounter in practical data science is unwarranted complexity in model choice and deployment.
